verdict.rationale: Omnara is an agent-hosting platform, not itself an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question for it. The evidence only shows client-side MCP support, where Omnara agents connect to external MCP servers such as Linear or Notion. Nothing shows Omnara exposing its own official MCP server for other agents to connect to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
